first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Blue Sky
entities.identification: The smooth sky region beyond the horizon, visible at the lower-right edge at the beginning of the clip and located in the upper right at the end of the clip, ranging from pale blue to bright white.

entities.name: Dry Grassland
entities.identification: The pale yellowish-brown ground surface occupying most of the frame, with alternating short grass, bare soil, and fine, rough textures.

entities.name: Scattered Trees and Shrubs
entities.identification: Sparsely branched trees and more compact vegetation crowns scattered across the grassland, accompanied by long shadows extending along the ground surface.

entities.name: Dirt Road and Linear Track
entities.identification: The pale brown band-shaped road surface and linear track in the grassland; a gently curving road band is visible in the upper right at the beginning of the clip, and a long, light-colored strip is visible on the far side in the later segment.

entities.name: Curved Ground Mark
entities.identification: Groups of nested, locally overlapping dark arcs and near-circular marks on the ground surface.

entities.name: Thin Light-Colored Strip at the Edge of the Frame
entities.identification: A pale white, slender outline that appears briefly near the lower-right edge of the frame; in frame 21, it is gently curved, and its visible segment is cut off by the frame.
